root.label: American Express anti-money laundering enforcement action

events.label: American Express anti-money laundering enforcement action

slots.name: fine amount
slots.sentence: American Express was fined $350 million by US bank regulators after they determined the lender's programs to identify potential money laundering were insufficient and the company potentially missed billions of dollars in suspicious activity.

slots.name: unidentified suspicious activity value
slots.sentence: The OCC said "systemic breakdowns" in its monitoring and reporting meant the lender failed to identify, evaluate and sufficiently report roughly $13 billion in suspicious activity over the past decade.

slots.name: announcement date
slots.sentence: The US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency and the Federal Reserve announced the enforcement action Thursday
